Constrained shortest path by Lagrangian relaxation (LARAC): each iteration is a plain Dijkstra on cost + lambda * resource, with a binary search driving lambda to the dual optimum. Returns a list with found; when TRUE also path (0-based nodes), edges (0-based input-order indices of the traversed edges), cost, resource, lower_bound (dual bound on the optimal cost; equal to cost proves optimality), lambda and iterations (Dijkstra runs).

Source: R/extendr-wrappers.R
rs_csp_lagrangian.Rd

Constrained shortest path by Lagrangian relaxation (LARAC): each iteration is a plain Dijkstra on cost + lambda * resource, with a binary search driving lambda to the dual optimum. Returns a list with found; when TRUE also path (0-based nodes), edges (0-based input-order indices of the traversed edges), cost, resource, lower_bound (dual bound on the optimal cost; equal to cost proves optimality), lambda and iterations (Dijkstra runs).

Usage

rs_csp_lagrangian(
  from,
  to,
  w_cost,
  w_resource,
  n_nodes,
  source,
  target,
  budget,
  max_iter
)
